CustomField.description: Name of the Business Hours (Setup > Business Hours) that define this entity's shipping days: its time zone and holidays decide whether an order ships today or on the next working day (order confirmation). Empty or not found = Europe/Amsterdam, Monday to Friday, no holidays.
CustomField.inlineHelpText: Name of the Business Hours (Setup > Business Hours) with this entity's time zone, working days and holidays, e.g. Shipping (NL). Empty = Europe/Amsterdam, Monday to Friday.
CustomField.label: Business Hours (Shipping)
